title: channel_id not validated (0-15 range)
description:
File: rust/lichen-gateway/src/discovery.rs
Lines: 227-234, 237-241, 262-286

The LoraGatewayAnnounce struct documents channel_id as '0-15' but accepts u8 (0-255) with no validation in:
- new() constructor (line 228)
- from_full_iid() (line 237)
- decode() (line 279)

Edge case trigger: Malformed LoRa frame with channel_id=255 decodes successfully. Downstream code attempting to tune to invalid channel could cause undefined behavior or silent corruption.

Fix: Add validation in decode() to reject channel_id > 15 with a new error variant. Constructor can use debug_assert! or return Result.
close_reason: Already fixed: channel_id validation exists in decode() (lines 291-294) returning InvalidChannelId error, new() has debug_assert (line 238), tests exist (lines 517-535). Note: discovery.rs is not exported in lib.rs so tests don't run - module appears to be development code not yet integrated.
